name: greater than 5, light red fill with dark red text
less than 3, yellow fill with dark yellow text
between 3 and 7, green fill with dark green text
text that contains "an", red text
conditionalFormatting: <conditionalFormatting sqref="B1:B10"><cfRule type="containsText" dxfId="0" priority="1" stopIfTrue="1" operator="containsText" text="an"><formula>NOT(ISERROR(SEARCH("an",B1)))</formula></cfRule></conditionalFormatting>

name: duplicate values, light red fill with dark red text
top 20%
conditionalFormatting: <conditionalFormatting sqref="A1:A10"><cfRule type="top10" dxfId="0" priority="1" percent="1" rank="20"/></conditionalFormatting>

name: bottom 2 items
conditionalFormatting: <conditionalFormatting sqref="A1:A10"><cfRule type="top10" dxfId="0" priority="1" bottom="1" rank="2"/></conditionalFormatting>

name: 3-color scale
conditionalFormatting: <conditionalFormatting sqref="A1:A10"><cfRule type="colorScale" priority="1"><colorScale><cfvo type="min"/><cfvo type="percentile" val="50"/><cfvo type="max"/><color rgb="FFF8696B"/><color rgb="FFFFEB84"/><color rgb="FF63BE7B"/></colorScale></cfRule></conditionalFormatting>

name: 2-color scale
conditionalFormatting: <conditionalFormatting sqref="A1:A10"><cfRule type="colorScale" priority="1"><colorScale><cfvo type="min"/><cfvo type="max"/><color rgb="FFFF7128"/><color rgb="FFFFEF9C"/></colorScale></cfRule></conditionalFormatting>

name: greater than 5, then less than 3 on the same cells
conditionalFormatting: <conditionalFormatting sqref="A1:A10"><cfRule type="cellIs" dxfId="1" priority="1" stopIfTrue="1" operator="greaterThan"><formula>5</formula></cfRule><cfRule type="cellIs" dxfId="0" priority="2" stopIfTrue="1" operator="lessThan"><formula>3</formula></cfRule></conditionalFormatting>
